name: Eco Club
description: The Eco Club promotes students' interest in environmental issues and fosters active student involvement to create an eco-friendly society through awareness, conservation, and education.
flagship_events: Eternity, Vanya Chaithanya, Spot Fixing in Hassan
activities: Action-based activities like tree plantation and maintaining a herbal garden on campus.
Cleanliness drives conducted both within and outside the college campus.
Placing display boards on selected campus trees specifying biological and common names.
Eternity: An event triggering eco-concern among engineering students.
Vanya Chaithanya: An event to imbibe concern for wildlife and wilderness in students in and around Hassan.
Spot Fixing: Annual initiative where the club cleans, immaculately restores, and maintains a public spot in Hassan city.
website: Official Website link in MCE records
achievements: Annual restoration and spot-fixing of public spaces across Hassan city; extensive herbal garden maintenance on campus.

name: Leo Club
description: LEO Club is the youth wing of Lions Club International at Malnad College of Engineering, Hassan. It is dedicated to youth leadership, community empowerment, and philanthropic service.
flagship_events: Annual Literary and Cultural Fests, Philanthropic Drives
activities: Conducting annual literary and cultural fests for students.
Organizing community service and philanthropic activities across Hassan district.
Youth leadership training and community development projects.
website: Official Website link in MCE records
achievements: Active philanthropic outreach and annual student fest organization as the youth wing of Lions Club International.

name: Literary Club (LIT)
description: Established in 1993, the Literary Club (LIT) is one of the oldest and most pivotal clubs at MCE. It comprises students from all years and celebrates the creative, literary, and artistic interests of students.
motto: To foster the talents and diverse interests of budding engineers with creative skills and a penchant for literature.
flagship_events: THE MALNAD FEST (Annual Fest with 35+ sub-events, Ethnic Day, DJ Night), NOESIS E-Magazine
activities: Organizes THE MALNAD FEST: The college's biggest annual 2-3 day festival featuring over 35 sub-events and attracting over 2,500 people.
Ethnic Day: Opening event celebrating national culture and heritage where students dress in traditional attire.
Balwaan: Inter-branch sports competition featuring Pentathlon, Tug of War, and strength challenges.
Buddhimaan: Intellectual mind contest featuring Toastmaster, Literati, and General Knowledge / Mystery Quizzes.
Darpan: Grand stage cultural event uniting the college with Group Singing, UV Foot-loose, and Vogue fashion.
Kalakruthi: Artistic creativity platform featuring Pot Painting, Chithrakatha, and canvas storytelling.
Sarvottam Title: Prestigious inter-branch championship awarded to the overall winning department.
NOESIS: Annual college e-magazine showcasing written works, artwork, and photography from students, faculty, staff, and alumni.
student_coordinators: Kalavathi H N (Student President, Ph: 9019871150), Sagar (Student Vice President, Ph: 9880768195)
website: Official Website link in MCE records
achievements: Hosts the largest college festival in Hassan with 2,500+ attendees and publishes the prestigious NOESIS e-magazine.

name: Rotaract Club of MCE
description: Rotaract Club of MCE is a voluntary youth wing of Rotary Club, Hassan. The motto of the club is to serve society in diverse ways for community well-being and develop leadership skills.
motto: Service Above Self - To serve society for their well-being
activities: REFLECTIONS: Major flagship competition providing an arena for school children in and around Hassan to showcase their talents.
TUSSLE: Mock recruitment and interview competition preparing engineering students for corporate placement drives.
Emergency Blood Donor Directory: Maintains verified blood group records of students for medical emergencies in Hassan.
Health & Welfare Drives: Community health awareness, Pulse Polio immunization camps, and rural assistance.
Personality Development: Professional workshops and outdoor leadership trekking expeditions.
website: Official Website link in MCE records
achievements: Continuous maintenance of emergency blood donation registry and hosting the prestigious REFLECTIONS inter-school fest.

name: DevOps Club
description: DevOps Club is a premier student technical community fostering innovation, modern software development practices, continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD), and hands-on cloud computing experience.
motto: Fostering innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning in DevOps
activities: HACK.MCE 1.0: 24-hour national-level coding hackathon on the theme 'Lifestyle' hosted in October 2018.
Dot Bytes: Campus navigation game ('Thief City') powered by a custom mobile application built from scratch by the club.
HACK.MCE 2.0 & 3.0: Techno-gaming and national hackathon fests featuring Gameathons in the canteen and main auditorium competitions.
Workshops on Linux system administration, Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation.
achievements: Organized three editions of national hackathon HACK.MCE and developed in-house mobile applications for campus events.

name: SPIC MACAY
description: Society for Promotion of Indian Classical Music And Culture Amongst Youth (SPIC MACAY) introduces students to the rich cultural heritage and classical art forms of India.
motto: Conserving and promoting Indian classical culture amongst youth
flagship_events: Classical Concerts, Heritage Workshops, Yoga & Meditation Sessions
activities: Organizing classical musical concerts and lecture-demonstrations by renowned artists.
Promoting Indian classical dance, folk arts, crafts, and yoga amongst students.
Workshops celebrating traditional Indian art forms and cultural preservation.
website: Official Website link in MCE records
achievements: Brings master classical artists to MCE campus to preserve classical art and cultural consciousness.

name: Science Association (SA)
description: Science Association spreads knowledge of science and technology for the betterment of society, catering genuine interest in scientific enquiry and providing practical dimensions to foundational engineering.
motto: Spreading knowledge of science and technology for the betterment of society
activities: SCIENTIA: Major state-level intercollegiate technical and science symposium featuring inter-branch and open technical competitions.
SMART: Science outreach event organized for school children in Hassan to provide early scientific exposure.
Science exhibitions, seminars, and National Science Day celebrations.
Hands-on experiments demonstrating foundational physics and chemistry principles behind engineering.
student_coordinators: Dhanush B S (Student Secretary), Tara B R (Student President), Ankitha Pal S D (Vice President), Muhammad Afnaan (Vice President)
website: Official Website link in MCE records
achievements: Hosts SCIENTIA technical symposium and conducts SMART outreach for young minds in Hassan district.

name: Malnad Technical Club (MTC)
description: Founded on 09-09-2009, Malnad Technical Club (MTC) is the premier student technical organization at MCE, seeding constructive technological ideas and nurturing engineering excellence.
flagship_events: ENIGMA (State & National Level Technical Fest), TECHSANDHYA Newsletter, THE SHOW
activities: ENIGMA: State-level technical festival with national-level competitions featuring 15+ events across 3 major domains.
Design & Build Events: Robokombat (combat robotics), Mystique Locomotor, Xtreme Machine, and Trail Blazer bot racing.
Online Events: MCE Dollars (virtual stock market simulation), Online Quizzes, Factual Reel competitions.
Paper Events: Inquizitive, Ingenium technical paper presentations, Play Bytes, and Resonance.
THE SHOW: Grand finale technical extravaganza featuring Laser Show, Drone Light Show, and Sand Art Show.
TECHSANDHYA: MCE's premier annual technical newsletter published during ENIGMA showcasing cutting-edge tech articles.
achievements: Founded in 2009; organizes ENIGMA (one of Karnataka's premier collegiate robotics and technical fests) and publishes TECHSANDHYA newsletter.

name: Enigma Technical Fest
description: ENIGMA is the flagship state-level technical festival organized annually by Malnad Technical Club (MTC) at MCE Hassan, drawing engineering participants from across Karnataka and neighboring states.
flagship_events: Robokombat, Laser & Drone Shows, MCE Dollars, Ingenium
activities: Robokombat: High-intensity bot battles in customized arenas.
Mystique Locomotor & Trail Blazer: Autonomous and wired obstacle navigation.
Ingenium: Research paper and technical presentation forum.
THE SHOW: Grand technical spectacles including drone formations, laser lights, and sand artistry.
achievements: Largest robotics and technical event in Hassan region with widespread state-wide participation.

name: FOSS Club
description: FOSS Club is dedicated to advancing Free and Open-Source Software, Linux operating systems, open developer tooling, and collaborative software development among engineering students.
motto: Freedom to Create, Collaborate and Innovate with Open Source
flagship_events: Open Source Workshops, Linux Install Fests
activities: Workshops on Git, GitHub, Linux kernel basics, and open-source contribution workflows.
Promoting open-source alternatives for proprietary engineering tools.
Collaborative open-source software project development.
achievements: Pioneering student-led open source software advocacy at MCE Hassan.

name: IUCEE EWB Student Chapter
description: A student chapter in partnership with Indo Universal Collaboration for Engineering Education (IUCEE) and Engineers Without Borders (EWB). Focuses on community engineering, student-oriented workshops, and industry collaborations.
motto: Build an ecosystem for engineers that exceeds the boundaries of conventional education
flagship_events: AAVISHKAR MANTHAN (Idea Thon, Elocution, Walkathon, Bonfire)
activities: AAVISHKAR MANTHAN: National-level event bringing students together across institutions to share innovative ideas and solutions.
Idea Thon: Problem-solving marathon for real-world societal engineering challenges.
Elocution, Walkathon, and networking Bonfire events fostering student leadership.
Implementation of valued student-oriented technical workshops and industry webinars.
achievements: National partnership with Indo Universal Collaboration for Engineering Education and hosts the AAVISHKAR MANTHAN national fest.

name: ASCE Student Chapter
description: The American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE) Student Chapter of MCE Hassan organizes professional development events, guest lectures, workshops, sports, and social campaigns for civil engineering students.
motto: Advancing Civil Engineering and Professional Excellence
flagship_events: Dr. C. Gifferd Satyadas Memorial Lecture Series, Technical Newsletters
activities: Organizing workshops, professional technical events, and sports tournaments.
Hosting social campaigns and lectures by distinguished industry personalities.
Publishing annual department newsletters and technical magazines.
Facilitating regular alumni-student professional interaction sessions.
website: Department of Civil Engineering, MCE Hassan
achievements: Active international professional student chapter running annual lecture series and technical publications.

name: SustaiNest (Civil Dept)
description: SustaiNest is a student club formed by the Department of Civil Engineering at MCE on 01.12.2023. It aims to promote sustainability awareness, green innovation, and professional skills in urban planning and environmental consultancy.
motto: Practicing Sustainability for a Resilient Future
flagship_events: Annual Sustainability Literacy Campaign, 6 Academic & Outreach Events
activities: Enhancing environmental and sustainability literacy across campus.
Organizing at least 6 diverse academic, outreach, and collaborative activities per year.
Platform for practical exposure in urban planning, waste reduction, and corporate sustainability.
Fostering student leadership, teamwork, and green innovation.
website: Department of Civil Engineering, MCE Hassan
achievements: Pioneering collegiate club founded in Dec 2023 committed to 6 annual sustainability initiatives.
